title: Love these
text: Love these. I love these bags and came back to order more. I was so disappointed to see that they were no longer available. I use these for everything and somewhere along the line I lost one. I actually think I gave someone one to use and never got it back, bummer!

features: STURDY EXTRA LARGE and LIGHTWEIGHT: Made of ripstop polyester which is ideal fabric for groceries. Hold up to 3-4 normal grocery bags of stuff. Durable, lightweight, larger sized and portable. Everything you desire for reusable grocery bags has been considered. We present you a more creative lifestyle.

EASY to FOLD and CARRY AROUND: Each bag is foldable with no effort and stored in its own pouch which NEVER get lost whereas it's handy enough to fit into coat pocket. Keeping one in your car and one in your purse you can always have them at hand doing grocery shopping and stop single use grocery bags from polluting the ocean.

CARRY HEAVY LOADS COMFORTABLY: The handles are double sided and wide enough so it will NOT dig into hands or shoulders even holding a ton of groceries. Carrying groceries in it is so much easier and keeps hands free to open doors. Not to mention it helps with our savings as well.

GIFT YOUR BELOVED A COOL GROCERY BAG SET: Bright colors make it a great choice as presents to your family, friends, co-workers or anyone you love. A small step towards minimizing our single use plastic.

LIFETIME EASY-TO-REACH NO-HASSLE WARRANTY: Just drop us a line and let us make it right for you. Your concern will be taken care of within 15 business hours. Any comment or advice from you would be much appreciated.
